title: Collision Repair Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Collision Repair: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Collision Repair Inspection Checklist covers damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need. The collision repair coordinator records Collision Repair criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Collision Repair Inspection Checklist keeps Collision Repair exceptions visible until the collision repair coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Collision Repair Inspection Checklist at intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point. Document damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need identity before Collision Repair begins. Compare damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need findings with stated Collision Repair criteria; route unresolved Collision Repair issues to qualified collision and structural repair reviewer. For Collision Repair Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Collision Repair. Ask qualified collision and structural repair reviewer to review Collision Repair conditions beyond the collision repair coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Collision Repair, identify responsible parties, intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point, and the linked damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need source.

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Collision Repair evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Collision Repair Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.guidance: Pause Collision Repair when structural, restraint, repair-method, calibration, alignment, or final safety verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Collision Repair proof and route unresolved damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need scope to collision repair coordinator.
